items.title: HRD: an integrated multi-omics resource for human reproduction and development
items.title_zh: HRD：人类生殖与发育的综合多组学资源
items.summary_zh: 摘要 人类生殖与发育是一个由遗传、分子和环境因素塑造的连续过程。然而，相关数据仍分散在公共存储库和文献中，限制了系统整合、分析和再利用。我们开发了人类生殖与发育数据库（HRD；http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/），这是一个综合多组学资源，组织与多个生殖、妊娠和发育背景相关的公开可用数据。HRD 1.0版包含814条组学记录，包括432条批量转录组、144条单细胞或单核转录组、156条表观基因组、52条代谢组和30条蛋白质组记录，以及702条临床试验记录、293条暴露-结局关联和779个带有 curated 表型关联的先导SNP。通过协调关键元数据并应用数据类型特定的分析工作流，HRD将组学数据、遗传关联、暴露-结局证据和临床试验数据纳入一个共同框架，以探索生殖和发育多个阶段的数据。该网站支持关键词搜索、组合筛选、基于类别的浏览、统计摘要和数据下载，并提供差异分析、功能富集

extra.description: Abstract Human reproduction and development span a continuum shaped by genetic, molecular, and environmental factors. However, relevant data remain dispersed across public repositories and the literature, limiting systematic integration, analysis, and reuse. We developed the Human Reproduction and Development Database (HRD; http://www.inbirg.com/hrd/), an integrated multi-omics resource that organizes publicly available data relevant to multiple reproductive, pregnancy, and developmental contexts. HRD version 1.0 contains 814 omics records, including 432 bulk transcriptomic, 144 single-cell or single-nucleus transcriptomic, 156 epigenomic, 52 metabolomic, and 30 proteomic records, together with 702 clinical trial records, 293 exposure-outcome associations, and 779 lead SNPs with curated phenotype associations. By harmonising key metadata and applying data-type-specific analysis workflows, HRD brings omics data, genetic associations, exposure-outcome evidence, and clinical trial data into a common framework for exploring data from multiple stages of reproduction and development. The website supports keyword search, combined filtering, category-based browsing, statistical summaries and data downloads, and provides interactive visualizations of differential analyses, functional enrichment, cell clustering, chromatin accessibility, peak annotation, regulatory networks, and cross-phenotype association plots. HRD supports the retrieval, comparison, and reuse of reproductive and developmental data and analysis results.

items.title: CALT-GNN: a graph neural network with cross-attention and long-tail experts for multi-omics cancer subtype classification
items.title_zh: CALT-GNN：一种用于多组学癌症亚型分类的交叉注意力和长尾专家图神经网络
items.summary_zh: 摘要 基于分子特征的癌症亚型分类对于表征肿瘤异质性、评估患者预后和支持精准治疗很重要。多组学整合提供了基因组、表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组层面的互补分子信息。然而，多组学数据的高维性、复杂的跨组学关系和不平衡的亚型分布仍是主要挑战。为解决这些问题，我们提出CALT-GNN，一种图神经网络框架，整合患者相似性图学习、基于交叉注意力的组学整合、长尾专家分类和可学习预测融合。该框架首先构建组学特异性患者相似性图，使用图卷积网络学习潜在患者表示，并通过相似性网络融合获得统一图。交叉注意力分支将CNA和DNA甲基化作为源模态，mRNA表达作为目标模态，建模互补关系。并行地，长尾专家分支使用主要和次要专家，配合原型引导路由，执行类别分布感知分类。两个分支的输出随后使用可学习全局权重组合。在八个TCGA多组学队列上的实验表明，CALT-GNN相对于代表性基线方法取得了有竞争力或可比的分类性能，并在对类别

extra.description: Abstract Cancer subtype classification based on molecular features is important for characterizing tumor heterogeneity, evaluating patient prognosis, and supporting precision treatment. Multi-omics integration provides complementary molecular information across genomic, epigenomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic levels. However, the high dimensionality of multi-omics data, complex cross-omics relationships, and imbalanced subtype distributions remain major challenges. To address these issues, we propose CALT-GNN, a graph neural network framework that integrates patient-similarity graph learning, cross-attention-based omics integration, long-tail expert classification, and learnable prediction fusion. The framework first constructs omics-specific patient-similarity graphs, learns latent patient representations using graph convolutional networks, and obtains a unified graph through similarity network fusion. A cross-attention branch models complementary relationships between CNA and DNA methylation as source modalities and mRNA expression as the target modality. In parallel, a long-tail expert branch uses Major and Minor Experts with prototype-guided routing to perform class-distribution-aware classification. The outputs of the two branches are subsequently combined using a learnable global weight. Experiments on eight TCGA multi-omics cohorts showed that CALT-GNN achieved competitive or comparable classification performance relative to representative baseline methods and stable performance on Macro-F1 and MCC, which are sensitive to class imbalance. Ablation and subtype-level analyses further supported the complementary contributions of cross-omics interaction modeling and adaptive long-tail expert routing, although the magnitude of the improvements varied across cohorts and subtypes. These results suggest that CALT-GNN provides a methodological framework for multi-omics cancer subtype classification under complex cross-omics relationships and imbalanced subtype distributions.

items.title: Ernie-Switcher: RNA foundation model-guided design of programmable RNA devices in a navigable landscape.
items.title_zh: Ernie-Switcher：RNA 基础模型引导的可编程 RNA 器件设计，在可导航景观中。
items.summary_zh: 生物基础模型的最新进展为数据驱动的分子工程带来了新机遇。然而，由于庞大、非线性的序列-结构-功能景观，设计可编程 RNA 器件仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 Ernie-Switcher，一个基于 RNA 基础模型（RNAErnie）构建的深度学习框架，包含三个相互耦合的组件：(i) 整合 RNAErnie 衍生的序列-表型表示，用于真实的设计生成和筛选；(ii) 表征 RNA 景观可导航性，作为序列优化的理论基础；(iii) 引入生物物理约束，使优化轨迹保持在生物学上合理的范围内。我们使用 RNA toehold 开关验证了 Ernie-Switcher。理论上，观察到的 RNA 景观阈值可导航性下界（86.4%）支持 RNA 开关序列优化的理论可行性。实验上，优化的 toehold 开关在大肠杆菌中实现了高达 35 倍的 ON/OFF 表达比。总体而言，RNAErnie 引导的序列优化

extra.description: Recent advances in biological foundation models have enabled new opportunities for data-driven molecular engineering. However, designing programmable RNA devices remains challenging because of the vast, nonlinear sequence-structure-function landscape. Here, we present Ernie-Switcher, a deep learning framework built upon the RNA foundation model (RNAErnie), comprising three coupled components: (i) integration of RNAErnie-derived sequence-phenotype representations for realistic design generation and filtering; (ii) characterization of RNA landscape navigability as a theoretical basis for sequence optimization; and (iii) incorporation of biophysical constraints to maintain optimization trajectories within biologically plausible bounds. We validated Ernie-Switcher using RNA toehold switches. Theoretically, the observed lower bound on threshold navigability (86.4%) of the RNA landscape supports the theoretical feasibility of RNA switch sequence optimization. Experimentally, the optimized toehold switches achieved ON/OFF expression ratios of up to 35-fold in Escherichia coli. Collectively, RNAErnie-guided sequence optimization provides a scalable strategy for engineering high-performance RNA devices. To facilitate broad adoption, we deployed Ernie-Switcher as a freely accessible web platform. The Python code and pre-trained models are available at https://github.com/zhutiblah/Ernie-Switcher and are archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21859277. The RNA toehold switch design platform is available at https://ernie-switcher.bioinformatics-syn.org/. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: SomatiX: accurate and efficient somatic SNV detection from matched tumor-normal long-read DNA sequencing.
items.title_zh: SomatiX：从匹配的肿瘤-正常长读长 DNA 测序中准确高效地检测体细胞 SNV。

extra.description: Accurate somatic single-nucleotide variant (SNV) calling from matched tumor-normal long-read DNA sequencing remains challenging because sequencing errors, variable tumor purity, tumor-in-normal contamination, and low variant allele fractions (VAFs) can obscure tumor-specific signals. Although recent deep-learning methods have improved long-read somatic variant calling, robust low-VAF detection and efficient genome-scale analysis remain important methodological challenges. We present SomatiX, a deep-learning method for somatic SNV detection from matched tumor-normal long-read DNA sequencing data, built on an allele-aware pileup representation. In comprehensive cancer benchmark analyses across diverse cell-line datasets, sequencing contexts, VAF bins, and minimum variant-supporting read thresholds, SomatiX outperformed DeepSomatic and ClairS in F1 score across most Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) benchmark conditions and achieved competitive performance on Pacific Biosciences (PacBio) data. Across the held-out chromosome 1 cancer cell-line benchmarks, at the threshold of ≥ 3 variant-supporting reads and VAF ≥0.05, SomatiX achieved mean F1 scores of 0.986 for ONT data and 0.988 for PacBio data. SomatiX showed particularly strong performance for low-VAF SNVs in ONT data while using a compact model and achieving the fastest runtime among the evaluated tools. SomatiX is available at https://github.com/colinliuzelin/SomatiX and archived at Zenodo under DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22062438. The repository includes source code, trained models, and benchmarking scripts. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: AbLWR: A Context-Aware Listwise Ranking Framework for Antibody-Antigen Binding Affinity Prediction via Positive-Unlabeled Learning.
items.title_zh: AbLWR：一种通过Positive-Unlabeled Learning进行抗体-抗原结合亲和力预测的上下文感知Listwise Ranking框架。
items.summary_zh: 准确预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力对于治疗设计和快速应对不断演变的病原体至关重要。然而，当前计算方法主要将其表述为point-wise回归任务。这种范式难以区分高度同源变体之间的细微亲和力差异，也缺乏有效优先排序顶级候选者所需的全局上下文。此外，该领域严重受限于标签稀疏性。尽管序列数据丰富，但经实验验证的亲和力数据稀缺，导致大量未验证的抗体-抗原结构相互作用未被标准监督范式利用。我们提出AbLWR（Antibody-antigen binding affinity Listwise Ranking），一种新颖框架，将传统亲和力回归任务重新表述为listwise ranking问题，以直接优化候选者优先级排序。为缓解标签稀疏性，AbLWR引入Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning机制，利用双层对比目标和元优化标签细化，从大量未标注数据中提炼稳健的结构表示。为适应抗原变异，

extra.description: Accurate prediction of antibody-antigen binding affinity is fundamental to therapeutic design and the rapid response to evolving pathogens. However, current computational approaches predominantly formulate this as a point-wise regression task. This paradigm struggles to discriminate subtle affinity differences among highly homologous variants and lacks the global context necessary to effectively prioritize top-tier candidates. Furthermore, the field is severely constrained by label sparsity. Although sequence data is abundant, experimentally verified affinities are scarce, leaving a massive pool of unverified antibody-antigen structural interactions unexploited by standard supervised paradigms. We propose AbLWR (Antibody-antigen binding affinity Listwise Ranking), a novel framework that reformulates the conventional affinity regression task as a listwise ranking problem to directly optimize candidate prioritization. To mitigate label sparsity, AbLWR incorporates a Positive-Unlabeled (PU) learning mechanism, leveraging a dual-level contrastive objective and meta-optimized label refinement to distill robust structural representations from vast unlabeled data. To accommodate antigenic variation, we employ a homologous antigen sampling strategy coupled with a Multi-Head Self-Attention (MHSA) module, which explicitly models inter-sample dependencies within training lists to capture subtle affinity nuances. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that AbLWR significantly outperforms state-of-the-art sequence-, structure-, and complex-based baselines. It improves the Full Rank Accuracy (FRA) by approximately 8% compared to the strongest baseline in randomized cross-validation, and exhibits strong robustness in out-of-distribution scenarios involving distinct antigen and antibody clusters. Case studies on Influenza Viruses and Human Interleukin-33 further validate its practical utility. Specifically, AbLWR successfully tracks affinity drops caused by antigenic drift and immediately captures optimal binders in simulated wet-lab screening. Source code and datasets are freely available at https://github.com/Josie-xufan/AbLWR. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified numerous loci associated with complex diseases and traits, yet the functional interpretation of non-coding risk variants remains challenging. Sequence-to-function models like AlphaGenome provide large-scale multi-modal predictions of variant effects, but their predictions lack direct experimental support. In contrast, empirical resources such as molecular quantitative trait loci (QTLs) and massively parallel reporter assays (MPRAs) offer population-based or experimental support for variant function, but suffer from limited genomic coverage. Here, we present VarNexus (https://biomed.imu.edu.cn/varnexus), an integrative resource for connecting disease-associated variants with predicted, population-based, and experimental evidence. VarNexus currently contains 230 404 fine-mapped candidate variants across 1891 disease-related phenotypes from UK Biobank and FinnGen. It integrates precomputed AlphaGenome predictions across 11 regulatory output types with bulk and single-cell xQTLs, MPRA measurements, and GWAS-eQTL colocalization results. VarNexus enables cross-linked searches by variant, phenotype, and gene, together with on-demand AlphaGenome prediction, multi-omics genome-browser visualization, and regulatory network exploration. By combining sequence-based predictions with population-based and experimental evidence, VarNexus provides a framework for prioritizing candidate regulatory mechanisms supported by multiple evidence layers.

items.title: Cell3D: a comprehensive database for interactive 3D visualization and crosstalk analysis of single-cell and spatial omics
items.title_zh: Cell3D: a comprehensive database for interactive 3D visualization and crosstalk analysis of single-cell and spatial omics
items.summary_zh: 摘要 单细胞和空间转录组学产生大规模、高维数据集。然而，跨特征整合探索受到限制，因为大多数当前平台支持单一数据类型，且缺乏用于多特征分析的交互式可视化。为满足这一未满足的需求，我们开发了Cell3D，一个可访问且多功能的交互式平台，旨在推进整合性多层次特征分析。Cell3D整理了898个公开可用数据集，包括397个单细胞和501个空间转录组数据集，涵盖来自11个物种的105种疾病、756种细胞类型和83个器官/组织中的2,924,646个单细胞和空间点。该数据库整合了12个主流功能注释系统，为在空间和细胞维度上剖析分子特征提供了全面图景。用户可以在多个层面探索数据，从基因表达和细胞簇到通路活性和临床表型。Cell3D提供了一套用户友好的功能，包括可定制的2D/3D交互式可视化，用于动态多层次特征投影；具有自动识别功能的灵活数据整合；定量串扰分析；以及聚焦微环境的整合分析，支持疾病研究和生物

extra.description: Abstract Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics yield large-scale, high-dimensional datasets. However, cross-feature integrative exploration is constrained, since most current platforms support a single data type and lack interactive visualization for multi-feature analysis. To address this unmet need, we developed Cell3D, an accessible and versatile interactive platform designed to advance integrative multi-level feature analysis. Cell3D curates 898 publicly available datasets, comprising 397 single-cell and 501 spatial transcriptomic datasets, encompassing 2 924 646 single cells and spatial spots across 105 diseases, 756 cell types, and 83 organs/tissues from 11 species. The database integrates twelve mainstream functional annotation systems, providing a comprehensive landscape for dissecting molecular features across spatial and cellular dimensions. Users can explore data at multiple levels, from gene expression and cell clusters to pathway activities and clinical phenotypes. Cell3D offers a suite of user-friendly functionalities, including customizable 2D/3D interactive visualization for dynamic multi-level feature projection, flexible data integration with automatic recognition, quantitative crosstalk analysis, and microenvironment-focused integrative analysis supporting disease research and biomarker discovery. Collectively, Cell3D enables exploration of tissue microenvironments at both cellular and spatial resolutions, bridging molecular perturbations and tissue architecture in health and disease. The database is freely accessible at https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/Cell3D.

items.title: SpatialRegNet: spatially resolved mapping of active regulatory network of human and mouse.
items.title_zh: SpatialRegNet：人类和小鼠活跃调控网络的空间分辨映射。
items.summary_zh: 空间微环境和细胞功能状态受时空动态基因调控网络（GRN）支配，因此解析它们对于理解疾病发病机制和正常组织程序至关重要。尽管多个空间转录组数据库快速发展，但大多数缺乏细胞内 GRN 及其空间耦合模式的系统整合。在此，我们提出 SpatialRegNet（https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/），一个综合数据库，整理了来自 152 个人类和小鼠空间转录组数据集的 1322 个组织切片，涵盖 68 种组织类型和 93 种不同疾病或疾病亚型，包含 3,744,216 个空间点。该数据库量化了 6733 个转录因子（TF）介导的调控子网络的点级活性，这些网络总共包含超过 1270 万个 TF-靶基因对，并归档了 802,935 个在不同空间生态位/细胞类型中高度活跃的调控子网络。SpatialRegNet 嵌入了一套交互式在线工具，用于在空间背

extra.description: The spatial microenvironment and cellular functional states are governed by spatiotemporally dynamic gene regulatory networks (GRNs), making their dissection essential for understanding disease pathogenesis and normal tissue programs. Despite the rapid development of multiple spatial transcriptomics databases, most lack systematic integration of intracellular GRNs and their spatial coupling patterns. Here, we present SpatialRegNet (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/SpatialRegNet/), a comprehensive database curating 1322 tissue slices derived from 152 human and mouse spatial transcriptomic datasets that span 68 tissue types and 93 distinct diseases or disease subtypes, encompassing 3 744 216 spatial spots. The database quantifies spot-level activity for 6733 transcription factor (TF)-mediated regulon networks, which collectively contain over 12.7 million TF-target gene pairs, and archives 802 935 regulon networks that are highly active in distinct spatial niches/cell types. SpatialRegNet embeds a suite of interactive online tools for analyzing regulon networks in spatial contexts, enabling users to interrogate the correlations between regulon network activity and cellular identities, map spatial regulatory heterogeneity and specificity, track dynamic regulon network activity across cell differentiation trajectories, reconstruct intercellular communication signaling cascades, and generate three-dimensional visualizations of regulon network activity. Collectively, SpatialRegNet constitutes a valuable public resource to advance mechanistic investigations of physiological tissue function, disease etiology, and biomarker discovery in spatially resolved GRNs.

items.title: 4D-atlas: a multi-species four-dimensional spatiotemporal transcriptomics database spanning development, regeneration, and disease.
items.title_zh: 4D-atlas：一个涵盖发育、再生和疾病的多物种四维时空转录组学数据库。
items.summary_zh: 四维（4D）空间转录组学可同时捕捉三维（3D）组织结构与时间进程中的分子图谱，对于解析发育、再生和疾病进展等动态生物过程至关重要。在此，我们推出4D-atlas（https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/4D-Atlas 或 https://4d-atlas.bio-database.com/），这是首个公开可访问的、专注于多物种4D时空转录组图谱的数据库。4D-atlas收集并标准化了来自六个物种、15个代表性数据集的1629个空间切片，跨越88个不同时间点，每个数据集2-41个时间点，包含超过2220万个细胞或空间spot，涵盖胚胎发育、组织再生和疾病进展。除数据收集外，4D-atlas提供七个交互式分析模块，支持对组织形态发生、空间基因模块、通路活性、调控网络、细胞-细胞通讯、发育轨迹和时间表达模式进行4D（3D空间+时间）探索。通过统一分析流程整合离散生物阶

extra.description: Four-dimensional (4D) spatial transcriptomics, which captures molecular landscapes across both three-dimensional (3D) tissue architecture and temporal progression, is essential for deciphering dynamic biological processes such as development, regeneration, and disease progression. Here, we present 4D-atlas (https://bio-bigdata.hrbmu.edu.cn/4D-Atlas or https://4d-atlas.bio-database.com/), the first publicly accessible database dedicated to multi-species 4D spatiotemporal transcriptomic atlases. 4D-atlas collects and standardizes 1629 spatial slices spanning 88 distinct time points with 2-41 per dataset and over 22.2 million cells or spatial spots from 15 representative datasets across six species, encompassing embryonic development, tissue regeneration, and disease progression. Beyond data collection, 4D-atlas provides seven interactive analytical modules that enable 4D (3D space + time) exploration of tissue morphogenesis, spatial gene modules, pathway activities, regulatory networks, cell-cell communication, developmental trajectories, and temporal expression patterns. Using a unified analytical pipeline to integrate 3D spatial architecture and molecular information across discrete biological stages, 4D-atlas enables systematic investigation of tissue morphogenesis and dynamic regulatory programs across time and space.

items.title: scSpatial: an atlas for single-cell spatial omics.
items.title_zh: scSpatial：单细胞空间组学图谱。
items.summary_zh: 单细胞空间组学（SCSO）通过在单细胞分辨率下同时实现分子表征和空间定位，重塑了空间分析，为理解天然生物背景下的细胞身份和组织结构提供了洞见。通过整合空间坐标与分子谱和细胞身份，SCSO数据集已被广泛用于构建空间分辨细胞图谱、表征疾病相关组织重塑以及绘制疾病相关细胞群体。然而，这些SCSO数据集仍分散于各独立出版物中，全面的SCSO资源仍然缺乏。因此，我们开发了scSpatial，一个具有专家策展细胞注释和高分辨率空间映射的SCSO图谱。当前版本的scSpatial策展了大规模SCSO数据集合，包含来自630个项目的1800多个组织切片，使用16种空间技术生成；提供超过2000万个空间分辨细胞，注释为173个标准化Cell Ontology类型；并提供SCSO定制分析和交互式可视化，包括空间基因表达图谱、细胞类型分布图、空间可变基因、基因表达相关性和通路级空间活性谱。scSpatial对所

extra.description: Single-cell spatial omics (SCSO) has reshaped spatial profiling by enabling simultaneous molecular characterization and spatial mapping at single-cell resolution, providing insights into cellular identities and tissue architecture within native biological contexts. By integrating spatial coordinates with molecular profiles and cell identities, SCSO datasets have been widely used to construct spatially resolved cell atlases, characterize disease-associated tissue remodeling, and map disease-relevant cell populations. However, these SCSO datasets remain fragmented across individual publications, and comprehensive SCSO resources are still lacking. Here, scSpatial was therefore developed as an atlas for SCSO with expert-curated cell annotations and high-resolution spatial mappings. items.title: LRP2: A proteogenomics pipeline for long-read informed protein isoform analysis and discovery.

extra.description: Most human genes produce multiple RNA isoforms, yet it remains unclear which isoforms are translated into stable, functional proteins. Long-read RNA sequencing resolves full-length transcript structures and, when paired with mass spectrometry, can provide empirical evidence of isoform translation. Despite this opportunity, comprehensive workflows integrating isoform discovery, open reading frame prediction, peptide identification, and protein inference remain limited, leaving users to handle these steps piecemeal. Here, we present LRP2, a modular, end-to-end long-read proteogenomics pipeline built in Nextflow. LRP2 scales transcript discovery to hundreds of samples via PacBio's latest Isocall tool, removes technical artifacts with SQANTI QC, generates and classifies predicted proteomes via CPAT and SQANTI Protein, performs multi-group differential expression and usage analysis via edgeR, DRIMSeq, and a long-read adaptation of LeafCutter, and integrates protein-level evidence from DDA and DIA MS data through FragPipe. For cross-dataset comparison of novel isoforms, LRP2 employs deterministic splice-junction, coordinate-based isoform identifiers. Used as an integrated pipeline, LRP2 enables the detection of novel peptides and improves protein isoform inference to confirm protein isoform translation. LRP2 is freely available as a modular Nextflow pipeline at https://github.com/sheynkman-lab/LRP2 (v2.0.0, archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22795865). LRP2 supports Docker, Apptainer/Singularity, and Conda environments with GENCODE references. Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

extra.description: Abstract Background Increased genome dosage can alter cellular and regulatory states, yet how vertebrate embryos maintain coordinated developmental progression following a whole-genome dosage increase remains unclear. Results Here, we examined developmental, transcriptomic, and DNA methylation patterns during cold-shock-induced triploid embryogenesis in large yellow croaker ( Larimichthys crocea ). Triploid embryos exhibited approximately 1.51-fold higher DNA content and reached major developmental stages at times comparable with diploid controls. Across eight stages, developmental stage rather than ploidy dominated global RNA-seq variation, indicating broad preservation of relative transcriptome composition. Stage-wise comparisons identified localized transcriptional differences concentrated primarily at the blastula and heartbeat stages. Stage-by-ploidy interaction analysis revealed distinct developmental expression trajectories involving RNA processing, embryonic patterning, extracellular matrix organization, and contractile development. Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing at three stages revealed extensive and bidirectional regional methylation differences. Relative to analyzable genomic windows, differentially methylated regions showed non-random enrichment across genomic contexts, including particularly strong enrichment in CpG islands and promoters. However, methylation–expression correlations across promoter, gene-body, exonic, and intronic contexts were uniformly weak. Among RNA-testable differentially methylated genes, only seven genes at the blastula stage and two at the heartbeat stage were also differentially expressed, and these overlaps were not greater than expected under independence. Conclusions Cold-shock-induced triploid embryos therefore retain broadly preserved developmental progression and relative transcriptome organization while exhibiting localized transcriptional differences and extensive, genomically structured methylation remodeling. The limited same-stage correspondence between methylation and expression indicates that regional methylation differences are not broadly associated with concurrent transcriptional divergence in bulk embryos.

extra.description: Abstract Genome-wide association studies (GWAS) identify loci associated with human diseases and disease-related traits, but the regulators and cellular contexts linked to these signals remain difficult to resolve. We present scTraitReg, a database of trait-relevant transcription factor (TF) eRegulons—TFs with their target genes and linked cis-regulatory regions—at single-cell resolution. scTraitReg integrates 655 sets of curated GWAS summary statistics covering 122 Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) disease terms with 111 human single-cell multi-omic datasets profiling RNA and chromatin accessibility in the same cells. The resource spans 34 tissues, 252 cell types, 2 081 538 cells, and 2208 curated GWAS—single-cell analysis pairs. Across these analyses, it contains 2 840 939 TF–cell-type records for 886 regulators; 67 666 records met all three criteria—cell-type specificity, genetic relevance, and the trait-associated regulon score—and were included as candidate trait-relevant eRegulon records. Each record links to the TF—target regulatory network with its cis-regulatory regions, cell-type-resolved evidence, per-cell regulon module scores, and target-gene enrichment, all available as downloadable tables. Users can search by disease, tissue, cell type, or regulator and examine these associations through interactive visualizations. scTraitReg thus provides a searchable and reusable resource linking genetic associations to cell-type-specific regulatory programs, and is freely available at https://www.sctraitreg.bio/.

items.title: SADRP: A structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction

items.summary_zh: 动机：预测不同癌症样本的药物敏感性是个性化治疗和药物发现中的基本挑战。该任务需要对药物和癌细胞系特征进行全面表征。当前方法往往无法充分捕捉药物化合物的复杂结构特征和相互作用，也难以整合来自同一样本的多组学特征，限制了其特征表示能力。因此，需要能够以统一方式联合建模分子结构特征和多模态细胞背景的建模框架。结果：我们提出SADRP，一个用于药物反应预测的结构感知多模态框架，旨在建模复杂分子结构和多组学数据。对于药物表示，SADRP结合了最短距离路径（SDP）编码和边编码，以捕捉拓扑关系和键类型化学语义。对于细胞系分析，多视图交互编码器整合基因表达和DNA甲基化，捕捉跨组学协同互补性。SADRP始终优于最先进的方法，同时还识别出潜在的治疗候选物和生物标志物，提供机制洞察并支持药物发现和个性化医疗中的应用。

extra.description: Motivation Predicting drug sensitivity across diverse cancer samples is a fundamental challenge in personalized therapy and drug discovery. This task requires comprehensive characterization of both drug and cancer cell line features. Current approaches often fail to fully capture the complex structural characteristics and interactions of drug compounds and struggle to integrate multi-omics features derived from the same sample, limiting their feature representation capacity. Consequently, there is a need for modeling frameworks that can jointly model molecular structural features and multi-modal cellular contexts in a unified manner. Results We present SADRP, a structurally aware multi-modal framework for drug response prediction, designed to model complex molecular structures and multi-omics data. For drug representation, SADRP incorporates Shortest Distance Path (SDP) encoding and edge encoding to capture both topological relationships and bond-type chemical semantics. For cell line profiling, a multi-view interactive encoder integrates gene expression and DNA methylation, capturing cross-omics synergistic complementarity. SADRP consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, while also identifying potential therapeutic candidates and biomarkers, providing mechanistic insights and supporting applications in drug discovery and personalized medicine.

items.title: ImmunEscpMap: a gene-centered knowledgebase for immune escape in cancer and viral infection

extra.description: Abstract Tumors exploit immune escape to evade elimination, whereas viruses remodel host immunity to replicate or persist. However, evidence to interpret these processes is fragmented across databases, literature, and omics analyses, hindering gene prioritization. To address this, we developed ImmunEscpMap, a gene-centered knowledgebase connecting cancer and viral-infection evidence within a unified immune-escape framework. The current release contains 55 711 gene-evidence records (53 911 PubMed records from 37 193 unique PMIDs and 1800 Gene Expression Omnibus records across 709 accessions) representing 667 distinct source genes (657 in cancer, 571 in viral infection, and 561 shared). Evidence is organized into eight immune-escape mechanisms and 14 viral contexts, with the cancer branch integrating multi-omics and clinical outcomes, and the viral branch separating mechanistic anchors from infection-associated evidence. The web interface supports identifier search, context browsing, literature views, interactive gene pages, and bulk downloads. ImmunEscpMap is freely available at https://iescpemap.cqmu.edu.cn/, providing a traceable cross-domain map to prioritize candidates and guide follow-up experiments.

extra.description: Analyses routinely conducted in both fundamental research and biomedical studies often report aggregate signals derived from heterogeneous mixtures of cells. These mixtures reflect the intrinsic anatomical and functional complexity of the tissues and organs from which they are derived. Such bulk measurements obscure cell-specific signals, thereby hindering accurate interpretation of the underlying biological processes. Here, we introduce CLIMB and CLIFF, a two-step machine-learning framework that deconvolves bulk RNA-seq into cell-type composition and expression, and then resolves bulk drug sensitivity measurements into cell subtype- and single-cell-specific profiles. We first validate CLIMB using in-vitro mixtures of leukemic cell lines with experimentally known cell-type proportions, then extend this validation to large-scale, cross-dataset pseudo-bulk analyses built from independent scRNA-seq references across two disease contexts and five cancer types — mimicking the reference-to-target mismatches encountered in real applications — and show that CLIMB accurately infers the cellular composition of bulk samples, outperforming state-of-the-art bulk deconvolution methods. We emphasize CLIMB’s effectiveness in acute myeloid leukemia, where it offers highly accurate estimation of leukemic stem cell fractions across three test datasets and three patient cohorts. We then validate CLIFF, our algorithm for estimating cell subtype- and single-cell-specific drug sensitivity, first on the same in-vitro cell line mixtures using experimentally measured drug responses, and then through in-depth, realistic-scale pseudo-bulk simulations. We applied our deconvolution strategy to the beatAML cohort dataset, currently the most extensive database of ex-vivo drug screening data. This analysis generated a cell subtype–resolved drug sensitivity landscape for 121 compounds, revealing multiple compounds putatively active against leukemic stem cells, including midostaurin, A-674563, SNS-032, and foretinib. Collectively, our work introduces a general computational framework for resolving bulk functional measurements at cell-type and single-cell resolution, providing an attractive new computational tool for drug development and precision medicine.

items.summary_zh: 物联网(IoT)中激增的流量, 影响了传感器等设备的数据传输。利用软件定义网络(SDN)技术可以优化网络性能, 提高数据传输质量。然而, 物联网中流量等网络状态的不断变化会影响软件定义网络控制平面的性能。研究软件定义物联网(SD-IoT)中的动态控制器部署问题, 以在流量变化时保证控制平面性能。考虑到物联网节点的能耗以及数据传输的特点, 在部署控制器时, 综合考虑延迟、控制可靠性以及能耗的影响, 并将该问题构建为马尔可夫博弈过程。为了同时兼顾单一控制器性能以及控制平面整体性能, 采用多智能体深度强化学习求解该问题。在部署阶段利用动作掩码屏蔽部分节点, 避免将控制器部署在性能不足或者供能不方便的节点。仿真实验表明, 与基于Louvain社区划分和基于单智能体深度Q网络(DQN)的部署算法相比, 所提算法可以更好地找到高性能的部署方案。

items.title: 云网融合环境下组合服务的动态重构

items.title: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.title_zh: 基于多信息融合的高速收费站拥堵检测算法
items.summary_zh: 在高速收费站拥堵检测场景中, 遮挡、阴影、景深等因素严重影响检测算法的精度, 基于单信息的拥堵检测算法无法准确反映收费站真实拥堵情况, 对此, 提出一种高速收费站多信息融合拥堵检测算法。首先采用目标检测算法检测目标区域车辆, 利用图像空间特征计算车道占用率; 其次利用Deep SORT目标跟踪算法与滑动平衡机制进行车流量综合估计, 减少因为遮挡和阴影导致的车辆误检、漏检问题; 最后利用基于光流信息熵的车速估计方法, 降低因景深变化导致的拥堵状态检测误差。通过融合3种不同维度信息得到拥堵指数, 拥堵指数聚类为5种拥堵类别以判断真实拥堵状态, 从而实现高速收费站的拥堵检测。实验结果表明, 在高速收费站拥堵数据集上, 采用多信息融合的拥堵检测算法准确率达到90.4%, 能够实现对收费站拥堵状态的准确检测。

items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: Macro Mondrian Conformal Risk Control
items.title_zh: 宏观Mondrian保形风险控制
items.summary_zh: 保形风险控制（CRC）将保形预测扩展到覆盖设置之外，以无分布且模型无关的方式控制一般单调损失函数。这使其非常适合高维目标问题，例如本工作所处理的语义分割任务。然而，CRC仅保证边际控制，意味着风险在数据分布上平均受控。在不平衡分布下，包含稀有对象的输入上的风险可能因此仍不受控，即使边际保证成立。我们提出一种新方法，在用户定义的域组上平均控制风险，借鉴了Mondrian保形预测和宏观覆盖算法。该方法依赖于一个分类法，即为每个数据点分配一个组的函数，并通过一个取决于其组概率的系数对每个点的风险重新加权，使稀有点的贡献大于常见点。我们在两个语义分割数据集上说明了该方法。

extra.description: Conformal Risk Control (CRC) extends conformal prediction beyond the coverage setting to the control of general monotone loss functions, in a distribution-free and modelagnostic fashion. This makes it well-suited to problems with high-dimensional targets, such as the semantic segmentation task addressed in this work. However, CRC guarantees only marginal control, meaning that the risk is controlled on average over the data distribution. Under imbalanced distributions, the risk on inputs that contain rare objects may therefore remain uncontrolled, even when the marginal guarantee holds. We propose a new method that controls the risk on average over user-defined groups of the domain, drawing on Mondrian conformal prediction and macro-coverage algorithms. The method relies on a taxonomy, that is, a function that assigns a group to each data point, and reweights each point's risk by a coefficient that depends on its group probability, so that rare points contribute more than common ones. We illustrate the approach on two semantic segmentation datasets.

items.title: Retriever-Free Retrieval: Navigating Documents with Decision Models
items.title_zh: 无检索器检索：用决策模型导航文档
items.summary_zh: 尽管语言模型已变得显著更强大，检索仍在很大程度上依赖词汇匹配或固定嵌入空间中的相似性。这造成了能力不对称：检索器找不到的内容，即使最强的生成器也无法恢复。我们提出DecisionRAG，它利用预训练语言模型的能力进行检索，使用决策模型在单次前向传递中联合评估候选分支，不生成任何token，并表明在共享上下文中评判候选者使其相关性估计具有可比性。就像浏览图书馆的人一样，DecisionRAG从广泛主题向下导航到单个段落，在每一层决定哪些分支值得探索。无需任务特定训练或第一阶段检索器，DecisionRAG在MultiDoc2Dial上以13.8个R@1点、在Natural Questions上以17.4个Hit@1点优于带8B重排序器的稠密检索。在四个基准上，包括一个包含268万篇维基百科段落的语料库，每次查询检索仅需0.7-1.8秒。

extra.description: While language models have become dramatically more capable, retrieval still largely relies on lexical matching or similarity in fixed embedding spaces. This creates a capability asymmetry: what the retriever fails to find, even the strongest generator cannot recover. We propose DecisionRAG, which brings the capabilities of pretrained language models to retrieval using decision models that jointly evaluate candidate branches in a single forward pass, without generating any tokens, and show that judging candidates in a shared context makes their relevance estimates comparable. Like a person browsing a library, DecisionRAG navigates the corpus's inherent structure from broad topics down to individual passages, deciding at each level which branches are worth exploring. Without task-specific training or a first-stage retriever, DecisionRAG outperforms dense retrieval with an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial and 17.4 Hit@1 points on Natural Questions. Across four benchmarks, including a corpus of 2.68 million Wikipedia paragraphs, retrieval takes just 0.7-1.8 seconds per query.

items.title: Auto-Research Arena: Benchmarking and Advancing Auto-Research in Language Modeling
items.title_zh: 自动研究竞技场：语言建模中自动研究的基准测试与推进
items.summary_zh: 随着自主研究系统能力增强，基准必须既评估其性能又支持有意义的研究进展。我们引入Auto-Research Arena，一个多目标基准，用于评估自主研究系统并发现语言建模中的想法。Arena通过在共享实验环境中将可接受性与改进分离来支持多样研究目标：模型质量和资源约束决定结果是否合格，而所选目标衡量合格结果中的进展。我们在语言模型预训练中实例化Arena，设置九个目标，涵盖模型、数据、训练和推理效率，并使用两个基础模型评估七种研究框架。Arena在研究目标上清晰区分现有框架，若干复杂方法被我们简单的顺序搜索基线超越，表明当前自动研究系统存在大量提升空间。除评估外，Arena揭示了与活跃研究方向一致的更广泛的模型和系统想法前沿。在质量驱动搜索中重用这些发现，可在匹配数据和FLOPs下获得更低训练损失，并在相同模型大小下获得更低留出BPB。总之，Arena为基准测试自主研究并扩展其在语言建模中的

extra.description: As autonomous research systems become more capable, benchmarks must both evaluate their performance and support meaningful research progress. We introduce Auto-Research Arena, a multi-target benchmark for evaluating autonomous research systems and discovering ideas in language modeling. Arena supports diverse research objectives within a shared experimental environment by separating admissibility from improvement: model quality and resource constraints determine whether a result qualifies, while the selected target measures progress among admissible results. We instantiate Arena in language model pretraining with nine targets spanning model, data, training, and inference efficiency, and evaluate seven research harnesses using two foundation models. Arena clearly differentiates existing harnesses across research objectives, with several sophisticated methods outperformed by our simple sequential search baseline, indicating substantial headroom in current auto-research systems. Beyond evaluation, Arena reveals a substantially broader frontier of model and system ideas aligned with active research directions. Reusing these discoveries in a new quality-driven search yields lower training loss under matched data and FLOPs and lower held-out BPB at the same model size. Together, Arena provides a common framework for benchmarking autonomous research and expanding its scope in language modeling. The code is available at https://github.com/Auto-Research-Arena/auto-research-arena

items.title: Patient-specific rubric-based evaluation of large language models across longitudinal cancer care
items.title_zh: 基于患者特定评分标准的大型语言模型在纵向癌症护理中的评估
items.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）在专科医学中显示出前景，但现有评估主要关注孤立临床接触，而非追踪临床责任在纵向护理路径中如何演变。在此，我们引入NPC-RubricBench，一个阶段感知基准，用于评估癌症护理连续体中的多阶段临床推理，以鼻咽癌作为定义疾病背景。该基准从两个癌症中心405名患者的纵向记录中整理，包含六个连续护理阶段的941个患者-阶段单元和跨越五个评估维度的17,688条患者特定原子标准，每项评估严格限制于决策时临床证据。评估30个通用和医学LLM显示，强诊断性能并未延续到下游护理。我们评估了30个通用和医学LLM，表明高诊断性能并未转化为改善的下游护理。相反，主要失败模式在各阶段间反转。明确决策错误主导解剖分期，占48.2%，而决策遗漏主导初始检查和治疗后随访，分别占33.4%和30.4%。在评估模型集中，医学适配模型的遗漏率高于通用模型。此外，改变查询粒度暴露了关键规范权衡：广泛

extra.description: Large language models (LLMs) show promise in specialty medicine, yet existing evaluations largely focus on isolated clinical encounters rather than tracking how clinical responsibilities evolve across a longitudinal care pathway. Here we introduce NPC-RubricBench, a phase-aware benchmark for evaluating multistage clinical reasoning across the cancer care continuum, using nasopharyngeal carcinoma as a defined disease context. Curated from longitudinal records of 405 patients across two cancer centers, the benchmark comprises 941 patient-phase units across six sequential care phases and 17,688 patient-specific atomic criteria spanning five evaluation dimensions, with each assessment strictly restricted to decision-time clinical evidence. Evaluating 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs revealed that strong diagnostic performance does not carry over to downstream care. We evaluated 30 general-purpose and medical LLMs, showing that high diagnostic performance did not translate into improved downstream care. Instead, the dominant failure modes reversed across phases. Explicit decision errors dominated anatomical staging at 48.2%, whereas decision omissions dominated initial work-up and post-treatment follow-up at 33.4% and 30.4%, respectively. In the evaluated model set, medically adapted models showed higher omission rates than general-purpose models. Moreover, varying query granularity exposes a critical specification trade-off: broad open-ended requests degrade Decision Quality across all 30 models, while more detailed, checklist-like prompts raise Decision Quality but reduce Evidence Faithfulness and Safety Adherence. Furthermore, NPC-RubricBench demonstrates that static diagnostic benchmarks are insufficient to ensure consistent clinical reliability over time, highlighting the importance of phase-adaptive safeguards in multistage medical AI.

items.title: Work Agents: Systems, Capabilities, and Optimization
items.title_zh: 工作智能体：系统、能力与优化
items.summary_zh: 随着基础模型从信息生成演进到数字工作执行，智能体越来越能够在工具、应用和工作流中完成复杂任务。然而，现有研究缺乏关于智能体如何可靠完成委托工作的统一视角。为填补这一空白，我们提出以工作为中心的系统级视角，将工作智能体视为结合基础模型和运行时框架的系统，在有状态工作空间中执行任务并交付可验证结果。我们引入两个互补维度——工作持久性和工作开放性——来表征工作条件，并根据任务范围和组织将数字工作分为五种形式。基于此框架，我们识别可靠工作执行所需的五个核心能力族，并考察模型优化、框架优化及其联合优化的方法。我们进一步从工作结果角度分析现有评估方法和指标。最后，我们讨论未来研究方向，包括持续工作委托、适应开放环境以及工作执行与能力提升之间的交互。本文为理解、优化和评估工作智能体提供了统一框架，支持开发能够交付可靠、可验证且具有实际价值工作成果的系统。

extra.description: As foundation models evolve from information generation to digital work execution, agents are increasingly capable of completing complex tasks across tools, applications, and workflows. However, existing research lacks a unified perspective on how agents reliably accomplish delegated work. To address this gap, we present a work-centric, system-level perspective that views work agents as systems combining foundation models and runtime harnesses to execute tasks in stateful workspaces and deliver verifiable outcomes. We introduce two complementary dimensions, work persistence and work openness, to characterize working conditions, and classify digital work into five forms according to task scope and organization. Building on this framework, we identify five core capability families required for reliable work execution and examine approaches to model optimization, harness optimization, and their joint optimization. We further analyze existing evaluation methods and metrics from the perspective of work outcomes. Finally, we discuss future research directions, including sustained work delegation, adaptation to open environments, and the interaction between work execution and capability improvement. This paper provides a unified framework for understanding, optimizing, and evaluating work agents, supporting the development of systems capable of delivering reliable, verifiable, and practically valuable work outcomes.

items.title: Reva: Real-Time Vulnerability Detection through Contextual Probing of Large Language Models
items.title_zh: Reva：通过大型语言模型上下文探测进行实时漏洞检测
items.summary_zh: 漏洞发现得越晚，修复成本越高。随着编码智能体生成代码的速度超过开发者审查速度，软件需要第一道防线来实时筛查每个新函数。LLM智能体最近已能够像安全专家一样发现真实世界漏洞：它们运行分析工具、探索周围代码、测试假设并权衡证据，然后形成自己的判断。然而，这种推理跨越许多模型调用，因此每个判定需要数分钟计算，对于实时筛查来说太慢。更快的检测器——微调深度学习模型或提示LLM直接给出判定——准确性较低：它们在没有智能体收集的上下文的情况下判断函数，而LLM生成的判定即使给出部分上下文也不可靠。我们提出REVA（实时漏洞分析），一种AI漏洞检测器，将智能体检测器背后的安全上下文和代码理解组件带入LLM的单次前向传递。对于每个新函数，REVA向LLM提供其模块的预计算威胁模型、轻量级静态分析发现和调用图信息。REVA利用训练过的探针在此上下文中读取LLM对新函数的内部表示。在PrimeVul的留出测试

extra.description: A vulnerability costs more to fix the later it is discovered. As coding agents generate code faster than developers can review it, software needs a first line of defense screening each new function in real time. LLM agents have recently become capable of finding real-world vulnerabilities by working as a security expert would: they run analysis tools, explore the surrounding code, test hypotheses and weigh the evidence before forming their own judgement. This reasoning, however, spans many model calls, so that each verdict takes minutes of compute, far too long for real-time screening. Faster detectors, which fine-tune deep learning models or prompt an LLM for a direct verdict, are less accurate: they judge a function without the context an agent gathers, and an LLM's generated verdict is unreliable even when given some of it. We present REVA (REal-time Vulnerability Analysis), an AI vulnerability detector that brings the security context and code understanding components behind agentic detectors into a single forward pass of an LLM. For each new function, REVA gives the LLM a pre-computed threat model of its module, lightweight static analysis findings and call-graph information. REVA leverages a trained probe to read the LLM's internal representations of the new function in this context. On PrimeVul's held-out test set, REVA on GLM-5.3-Flash reaches 60.0% accuracy in about one second per function. This matches VulTriage (59.2%), the state-of-the-art agentic detector, run on the same LLM, while being over 250 times faster and less than a tenth as costly. On the same prompt, the probe is 14% to 17% more accurate than the LLM's own direct verdict. Across three open LLMs, REVA is at least as accurate as VulTriage, and about 10% more accurate on two of them. An LLM's internal representations thus encode much of what agentic detectors obtain through reasoning.

items.title: Does VGGT Know What It Does Not Know?
items.title_zh: VGGT知道自己不知道什么吗？
items.summary_zh: 前馈3D重建模型如VGGT在单次前向传递中回归相机和几何，但它们不报告所预测相机姿态的不确定性：错误的相对姿态看起来与正确姿态没有区别。我们追问冻结模型是否仍然知道其姿态何时错误。在HardMatch——一个包含1,000个故意困难图像对的基准上，VGGT在35%的对上失败——对VGGT冻结特征的线性探针在留出类别上预测姿态失败的ROC-AUC为93.5%，而VGGT自身点图置信度为79.7%，在VGGT所有输出上训练的分类器为77.7%。该探针捕捉到VGGT自信的失败，让下游系统对其不信任的对弃权，并无需重新训练即可迁移到PhotoTourism和ScanNet-1500上的旋转失败，超出共视所能解释的范围。这一知识不存在于逐图像编码器中：它是在融合两个视图的层中间计算的，第二个模型$π^3$也是如此。本质上，我们发现VGGT对其自身失败的了解多于其报告的内容。

extra.description: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models such as VGGT regress cameras and geometry in a single forward pass, but they report no uncertainty for the camera poses they predict: an incorrect relative pose looks no different from a correct one. We ask whether the frozen model nonetheless knows when its pose is wrong. On HardMatch, a benchmark of 1,000 deliberately difficult image pairs on which VGGT fails on 35% of pairs, a linear probe on VGGT's frozen features predicts pose failure on held-out categories with ROC-AUC 93.5%, compared with 79.7% for VGGT's own point-map confidence and 77.7% for a classifier trained on all of VGGT's outputs. The probe catches failures VGGT is confident about, lets a downstream system abstain on the pairs it distrusts, and transfers without retraining to rotation failures on PhotoTourism and ScanNet-1500, beyond what co-visibility explains. This knowledge is absent from the per-image encoder: it is computed partway through the layers that fuse the two views, and the same holds for a second model, $π^3$. In essence, we find that VGGT knows more about its own failures than it reports.

items.title: FOCUS: Active Critic Learning for Long-Horizon Language Model Agents
items.title_zh: FOCUS：长时程语言模型智能体的主动评论家学习
items.summary_zh: 稀疏结果奖励使长时程语言模型智能体难以将信用分配给早期动作。学习到的评论家为中间状态提供价值估计，但这些估计可能不准确，而从轨迹内各点重复续写样本估计中间价值会产生大量成本。为缓解这些问题，我们引入FOCUS，一种使用选择性分支帮助评论家网络学习其价值估计器的RL方法。 rollout控制器通过从预期最能降低评论家估计误差的状态采样续写，促进评论家的主动学习。这些精炼的价值估计随后用TD($λ$)优势对连续状态之间的段进行评分，而采样证据为评论家提供训练目标。FOCUS通过模块化上下文管理接口支持长时程智能体强化学习，该接口将上下文管理与rollout分配解耦。我们的实验表明，使用压缩诱导的段边界进行价值估计和信用分配，FOCUS在匹配每步生成预算的情况下，在法律推理、深度搜索和代码定位基准上优于GRPO和VinePPO，在Qwen3.5-9B规模上，BrowseComp-Plus的留出准

extra.description: Sparse outcome rewards make it difficult for long-horizon language-model agents to assign credit to earlier actions. Learned critics provide value estimates for intermediate states, but these estimates can be inaccurate, while estimating intermediate values with repetitive continuation samples from points within a trajectory incurs substantial costs. To mitigate these issues, we introduce FOCUS, an RL method that uses selective branching to help the critic network learn its value estimator. The rollout controller facilitates active learning for the critic by sampling continuations from states that are expected to most reduce the critic's estimation error. These refined value estimates then score the segment between consecutive states with a TD($λ$) advantage, while the sampled evidence supplies training targets for the critic. FOCUS supports long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning through a modular context-management interface that decouples context management from rollout allocation. Our experiments show that using compaction-induced segment boundaries for value estimation and credit assignment, FOCUS outperforms GRPO and VinePPO with matched per-step generation budgets on legal reasoning, deep search, and code localization benchmarks, improving held-out accuracy at Qwen3.5-9B scale by 7.2 points over the strongest baseline on BrowseComp-Plus (55.4 vs. 48.2) and by 4.1 points on DeonticBench (56.5 vs. 52.4).

items.title: A theory of noisy linear recurrent neural network learning dynamics
items.title_zh: 噪声线性循环神经网络学习动力学理论
items.summary_zh: 生物神经网络是有噪声的：其动力学涉及难以预测的波动，这些波动可能不仅源于混沌，还源于多种低层生物物理过程。尽管内在噪声无处不在，其理论后果仍未完全理解，尤其是在学习背景下。例如，噪声是否有意义地塑造表征学习，还是最好将其视为一种干扰因素，其存在与否对找到什么解以及何时找到解影响不大？在此，我们认为内在噪声可以显著调节循环神经网络（RNN）中的表征学习，因为它可以强烈打破解空间简并性，并在某些情况下控制非简并解是否存在。我们证明，对于一个具有线性激活函数和白噪声输入的噪声RNN学习的可解析处理模型，这一点成立。我们发现，在所谓的丰富区域（权重以小值初始化），噪声强烈调节读入、读出和循环权重对齐的方向。此外，我们发现噪声产生一种相变：对于足够高的噪声，如果参数尺度受限（例如通过正则化），非简并解甚至不是最优的。这些结果扩展了近期关于RNN表征学习的解析工作，并表明噪声可以作为表征的基本决定因素

extra.description: Biological neural networks are noisy: their dynamics involve difficult-to-predict fluctuations which are likely due not just to chaos, but also to a variety of low-level biophysical processes. Despite the omnipresence of intrinsic noise, its theoretical consequences are incompletely understood, especially in the context of learning. For example, does noise meaningfully shape representation learning, or is it better viewed as a nuisance factor whose presence or absence changes little about what solution is found and when? Here, we argue that intrinsic noise can significantly modulate representation learning in recurrent neural networks (RNNs), since it can strongly break solution-space degeneracies and in some cases control whether a non-degenerate solution exists at all. We show that this is true for an analytically tractable model of noisy RNN learning with a linear activation function and white noise inputs. We find that, in the so-called rich regime (where weights are initialized with small values), noise strongly modulates the directions in which the read-in, readout, and recurrent weights align. Moreover, we find that noise produces a kind of phase transition: for sufficiently high noise, a non-degenerate solution is not even optimal if parameter scales are limited (e.g., via regularization). These results extend recent analytic work on RNN representation learning and show that noise can act as a fundamental determinant of representations.

items.title: Improving Signals, Declining Encoder: A Known-Answer Test of Label-Free Monitoring in Self-Supervised Learning
items.title_zh: 信号改善，编码器退化：自监督学习中无标签监控的已知答案测试
items.summary_zh: 自监督训练通过损失和学习特征的统计量在无标签情况下进行监控。我们报告一个案例，其中我们知道编码器失去了部分已学到的内容，因此可以检查这些信号是否注意到。我们在具有已知生成因子的合成图像上训练LeJEPA编码器。在十个种子中的九个里，这些因子的可读性突然下降并保持低位，几乎总是沿因子空间中的同一方向。与此同时，损失持续下降，我们追踪的十一个无标签信号中的大多数持续改善，并将下降的运行评为优于未下降的运行。标准变化点检测很少在下降开始时附近标记，而通过这些信号选择检查点大多选择下降之后的检查点。

extra.description: Self-supervised training is monitored without labels, through the loss and statistics of the learned features. We report a case where we know the encoders lost part of what they had learned, so we can check whether these signals noticed. We trained LeJEPA encoders on synthetic images with known generating factors. In nine of ten seeds, the readability of those factors fell abruptly and stayed down, nearly always along the same direction in factor space. Meanwhile the loss kept falling, and most of the eleven label-free signals we tracked kept improving and rated the declining runs better than runs that did not decline. Standard change-point detection rarely flagged the decline near its onset, and selecting checkpoints by these signals mostly chose ones after it.

items.title: Do Similarity Measures Measure Similarity? How User Activity Creates Phantom Correlation in Recommender Systems
items.title_zh: 相似性度量衡量相似性吗？用户活动如何在推荐系统中制造幻影相关性
items.summary_zh: 物品-物品相似性是推荐系统中最古老、最基础的信号之一：当相同用户消费两个物品时，假定它们相似。尽管交互数据稀疏且规模庞大，该领域的隐含假设是物品共现反映真实共享偏好，捕捉用户共同喜欢的内容。在本文中，我们证明观察到的物品-物品相似性中有相当一部分是用户活动方差的伪影，而非共享品味。即使每个用户完全独立地消费物品，仅总消费量不同，标准相似性度量仍会检测到物品之间的强关联。我们将这一现象称为幻影相关性：在完全不存在偏好结构的情况下，严格由异质用户活动产生的虚假物品关联。从最小形式假设出发，我们证明不同活动下的独立消费由Rasch模型描述，并推导出所得关联如何依赖物品流行度，对每种相似性度量分别给出。通过将我们的理论基线与真实世界基准数据集比较，我们揭示了流行相似性度量反映幻影相关性的程度，这关系到物品共现在协同过滤中如何被解释和使用。

extra.description: Item-item similarity is one of the oldest and most foundational signals in recommender systems: two items are assumed to be similar when the same users consume them. Despite the sparsity and scale of interaction data, the implicit assumption across the field is that item co-occurrence reflects genuine shared preference, capturing what users like together. In this paper, we demonstrate that a substantial fraction of observed item-item similarity is an artifact of variance in user activity rather than shared taste. Even if every user consumed items completely independently, differing only in their total consumption volume, standard similarity measures still detect strong associations between items. We term this phenomenon phantom correlation: spurious item association that emerges strictly from heterogeneous user activity in the complete absence of preference structure. Starting from minimal formal assumptions, we show that independent consumption under varying activity is described by a Rasch model, and we derive how the resulting association depends on item popularity for each similarity measure. By comparing our theoretical baseline against real-world benchmark datasets, we reveal the extent to which popular similarity measures reflect phantom correlation, which bears on how item co-occurrence is interpreted and used in collaborative filtering.

items.title: EEGaze: Multimodal Attention Prediction in Visual Search via EEG-Based Saliency Refinement
items.title_zh: EEGaze：通过基于EEG的显著性精炼进行视觉搜索中的多模态注意力预测
items.summary_zh: 视觉搜索在日常生活中无处不在，从在凌乱公寓中找钥匙到在杂乱车间中找工具，或在桌面屏幕上找应用图标。虽然视觉注意力在很大程度上由图像内容驱动，但心理学研究表明用户认知状态对注意力分配有显著影响。获取认知状态信息的一种有前景的方式是通过脑电图（EEG）记录。尽管有这一潜力，以往计算注意力建模工作在很大程度上忽视了EEG，而心理学相关研究使用抽象、简单刺激，甚至人工引导的搜索程序。我们通过两项贡献弥合这一差距。首先，我们提出EEGaze 140，最大的公开可用真实刺激自由视觉搜索多模态数据集。该数据集包含36名参与者在140个自然场景中的同步EEG和眼动追踪记录，涵盖两种场景：搜索桌面图标和在杂乱车间场景中找工具。其次，我们引入EEGazeNet，首个整合EEG信号的视觉搜索人类注意力预测方法。我们的方法包括一个EEG引导的精炼阶段，将最先进显著性预测方法的输出适应用户当前认知状态。在EEGaz

extra.description: Visual search is ubiquitous in daily life, from locating keys in a messy apartment to finding a tool in a cluttered workshop or an application icon on a desktop screen. While visual attention is to a large extent driven by image content, research in psychology indicates that user cognitive states have a significant influence on attention allocation. A promising way to access information about cognitive states is via Electroencephalography (EEG) recordings. Despite this potential, previous works in computational attention modeling have largely disregarded EEG, and related studies in psychology operate with abstract, simplistic stimuli, or even artificially guided search procedures. We bridge this gap with two contributions. First, we present EEGaze 140, the largest publicly available multimodal dataset of free visual search with realistic stimuli. The dataset contains synchronized EEG and eye tracking recordings from 36 participants across 140 naturalistic scenes, covering two scenarios: searching for desktop icons and finding tools in cluttered workshop scenes. Second, we introduce EEGazeNet, the first method for human attention prediction in visual search that integrates EEG signals. Our approach consists of a EEG guided refinement stage that adapts the output of a state of the art saliency prediction method to the user current cognitive state. In comprehensive evaluations on EEGaze 140, we show that EEGazeNet consistently outperforms all baselines and ablation conditions.

items.title: CLOSURE: Cross-Channel Closure for Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection
items.title_zh: CLOSURE：用于多变量时间序列异常检测的跨通道闭包
items.summary_zh: 工业装置和服务器集群产生的多变量时间序列处于持续监控之下，异常检测是局部故障升级为系统级故障前的第一道防线。在缺乏标签的情况下，主流范式在正常数据上训练重建模型并对残差评分以作出判定。近期工作通过Transformer、扩散模型和跨尺度关联稳步丰富了恢复图的表达能力。然而，残差仅证明观测可以被恢复；它并不证明变量之间仍像正常运行时那样相互解释。协调但不熟悉的运行转变会膨胀残差而不破坏任何关系，而传感器偏离其同伴可能使残差保持沉默。将变量间依赖纳入重建目标的方法继承了这种模糊性，因为它们的关系证据最终由相同的恢复损失监督。因此我们提出CLOSURE，将可恢复性和跨通道一致性作为两个分别学习的正常数据预测任务来评估。可恢复性任务由以正常时间基的离散记忆为条件的扩散重建器解决。一致性任务由关系闭包算子解决，该算子仅从其他通道预测每个通道，目标自身的轨迹被扣留，稀疏符号门决定实际使用哪些同伴。两个

extra.description: Multivariate time series produced by industrial installations and server clusters are under continuous monitoring, and anomaly detection is the first line of defense before a local fault escalates into a system-wide failure. In the absence of labels, the dominant paradigm trains a reconstruction model on normal data and scores the residual to reach a verdict. Recent work has steadily enriched the expressiveness of the recovery map through Transformers, diffusion models, and cross-scale associations. A residual, however, only certifies that an observation can be recovered; it does not certify that the variables still explain one another as they do under normal operation. A coordinated yet unfamiliar operating transition inflates the residual without breaking any relationship, whereas a sensor drifting away from its peers may leave the residual silent. Methods that fold inter-variable dependencies into the reconstruction objective inherit this ambiguity, because their relational evidence is ultimately supervised by the same recovery loss. We therefore propose CLOSURE, which evaluates recoverability and cross-channel consistency as two normal-data prediction tasks learned in separation. The recoverability task is solved by a diffusion reconstructor conditioned on a discrete memory of normal temporal bases. The consistency task is solved by a relation-closure operator that predicts every channel exclusively from the others, where the target's own trajectory is withheld and sparse signed gates decide which peers are actually used. The two scores are reconciled only through calibration on normal data. Extensive experiments show that CLOSURE consistently outperforms recent reconstruction-, frequency-, and topology-based detectors on public benchmark streams, confirming the value of examining consistency alongside recoverability.

items.title: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Using Routed Ensembles and Trajectory Attribution
items.title_zh: 使用路由集成和轨迹归因的多目标强化学习
items.summary_zh: 多目标强化学习是现代AI的基本问题，应用涵盖后训练、推理模型和机器人控制。一个核心挑战是学习平衡竞争目标的策略，例如安全与对齐中的有用性与诚实性，或机器人中的速度与能耗。最优策略可能随目标加权组合急剧变化，而这种变化的程度关键取决于目标之间的冲突程度，使得逐偏好策略学习样本效率低下。在本文中，我们引入目标冲突系数，并使用该度量推导在线设置的近最优遗憾界，从而量化错位对学习效率的影响。然后，我们设计路由集成策略学习，一种维护一小组基策略并动态将轨迹路由到潜在奖励最高策略的算法。最后，我们将轨迹选择视为缓解目标冲突的另一种方法，并设计核代理轨迹归因算法，估计一组轨迹的反馈信号如何影响其他轨迹上的策略学习。该核可以捕捉轨迹之间的协同和拮抗等非线性交互。我们在多样环境和基准上评估我们的方法：路由集成在Meta-World和MO-Gymnasium的在线环境中比基线平均性能提高4.3%，核代理归因与

extra.description: Multi-objective reinforcement learning is a fundamental problem for modern AI, with applications spanning post-training, reasoning models, and robotic control. A central challenge is to learn policies that balance competing objectives, such as helpfulness versus honesty in safety and alignment, or speed versus energy in robotics. The optimal policy can vary sharply with objective-weighting combinations, and the extent of this variation depends crucially on the degree of conflict among objectives, making per-preference policy learning sample-inefficient. In this paper, we introduce objective-conflict coefficients and derive near-optimal regret bounds for online settings using this measure, thereby quantifying the impact of misalignment on learning efficiency. Then, we design routed ensemble policy learning, an algorithm that maintains a small set of basis policies and dynamically routes trajectories to the policy with the highest potential reward. Finally, we consider trajectory selection as another approach to mitigate objective conflict, and design a kernel surrogate trajectory attribution algorithm that estimates how feedback signals from a set of trajectories influence policy learning on other trajectories. The kernel can capture nonlinear interactions such as synergy and antagonism between trajectories. We evaluate our approach across diverse environments and benchmarks: routed ensembles improve average performance by 4.3% over baselines for online environments from Meta-World and MO-Gymnasium, and kernel surrogate attribution improves correlation with leave-one-out analysis over existing baselines by 50%. When applied to trajectory selection, kernel-based attribution yields a 27% improvement in reward over baseline attribution methods.

items.title: TRACE: Memory-Efficient Time Series Class-Incremental Learning via Temporal-Spectral Reconstruction
items.title_zh: TRACE：通过时谱重建实现内存高效的时间序列类增量学习
items.summary_zh: 网络连接的传感应用持续生成具有演变行为类别的多变量时间序列，使得时间序列类增量学习（TSCIL）对于在不遗忘先前获得知识的情况下适应新类别至关重要。然而，在严格隐私和内存约束下保持多样且演变的类别分布仍是基本挑战。现有方法往往在保留足够历史知识以准确识别和最小化持续适应所需内存之间面临权衡。为解决这些限制，我们提出TRACE，一个内存高效、无回放框架，通过生成建模而非样本排练来保留类别特定知识。TRACE采用紧凑的冻结时谱表示和轻量级类别特定自编码器来捕捉复杂的类内变化。通过独立保留每个类别模型，TRACE避免递归生成和灾难性遗忘，同时通过基于重建的评分实现直接分类，无需保留历史样本或大型统计矩阵。在五个TSCIL基准上的大量实验表明，TRACE实现有竞争力的分类准确率，同时与TS-ACL（评估的最强分析基线）相比平均保留内存减少约98.26%，并在GrabMyo上实现约33.43%的相对

extra.description: Web-connected sensing applications continuously generate multivariate time series with evolving behavioral categories, making Time Series Class-Incremental Learning (TSCIL) essential for adapting to new classes without forgetting previously acquired knowledge. However, preserving diverse and evolving class distributions under strict privacy and memory constraints remains a fundamental challenge. Existing approaches often face a trade-off between retaining sufficient historical knowledge for accurate recognition and minimizing the memory required for continual adaptation. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a memory-efficient, replay-free framework that preserves class-specific knowledge through generative modeling rather than sample rehearsal. TRACE employs a compact, frozen temporal-spectral representation and lightweight class-specific autoencoders to capture complex intra-class variations. By independently preserving each class model, TRACE avoids recursive generation and catastrophic forgetting, while enabling direct classification through reconstruction-based scoring without retaining historical samples or large statistical matrices. Extensive experiments across five TSCIL benchmarks demonstrate that TRACE achieves competitive classification accuracy while reducing mean retained memory by approximately 98.26% compared with TS-ACL, the strongest evaluated analytical baseline, and achieving an approximately 33.43% relative improvement in accuracy on GrabMyo.

items.title: Detecting bus delays and service anomalies in Niterói with autoencoder latent feature representations
items.title_zh: 用自编码器潜在特征表示检测Niterói的公交延误和服务异常
items.summary_zh: 公交乘客通过两种失败判断服务：单次行程晚点，以及整个系统表现失常的日子。我们追问原始GPS遥测的一种无监督表示能否在NetMob 2026 Niterói公交数据集上服务于这两种诊断。自编码器将每次行程压缩为64维潜在向量；冻结编码器馈入监督延误分类器，重建误差作为异常分数。两项发现是负面的。第一，潜在表示并未改善延误检测：基于每次行程汇总特征的梯度提升达到$0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC，而最佳潜在设置为$0.838 \pm 0.016$，一旦放宽预处理过滤器，差距变得显著。第二，异常分数的三项外部检查中有两项是循环的。无降雨重新训练消除了降雨关联（标记率5.4%对5.0%，$p = 0.84$）以及3月23日明显的全市中断。幸存的是跨三个自编码器稳定的日级信号（Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$），主要由日类型驱动，退化遥测日在工作日和周末分层内仍可区分。警报

extra.description: Bus riders judge service by two failures: single trips that run late, and days on which the whole system misbehaves. We ask whether one unsupervised representation of raw GPS telemetry can serve both diagnoses on the NetMob 2026 Niterói bus dataset. An autoencoder compresses each trip into a 64-dimensional latent vector; the frozen encoder feeds supervised delay classifiers, and the reconstruction error serves as an anomaly score. Two findings are negative. First, the latent representation does not improve delay detection: gradient boosting on per-trip summary features reaches $0.846 \pm 0.013$ ROC-AUC against $0.838 \pm 0.016$ for the best latent setup, and the gap becomes significant once the preprocessing filters are relaxed. Second, two of the three external checks of the anomaly score were circular. Retraining without rainfall removes the rain association ($5.4\%$ against $5.0\%$ flagged, $p = 0.84$) and an apparent citywide disruption on 23 March. What survives is a day-level signal stable across three autoencoders (Spearman $ρ\geq 0.96$), driven mostly by day type, with degraded-telemetry days still separable within weekday and weekend strata. The alarm threshold limits detection more than the score does: a pooled percentile cut flags $5.7\%$ of trips on the worst degraded day, while re-scaling within each bus line flags $29.3\%$. The delay model rests almost entirely on one feature, no latent dimension is individually interpretable, and 22 chronic line-directions carry half of all delayed trips.

items.title: Triage: Skip, Skim, or Refine Attention Tiles in Video Diffusion Transformers
items.title_zh: Triage：在视频扩散Transformer中跳过、略读或精炼注意力块
items.summary_zh: 对数万视觉token的注意力主导视频扩散Transformer（DiT）的推理。现有方法通过稀疏性、低精度或两者降低这一成本，但对所有保留块使用单一精度。我们观察到近似引入的输出误差在不同块之间差异很大。许多块可以几乎无误差地跳过，其他块必须计算但低精度之外收益甚微，少数块即使在低精度下仍保留显著误差。我们提出Triage，一种免训练注意力方法，为每个块分配三种近似层级之一：用块均值替换以跳过，以NVFP4略读，或用NVFP4残差校正精炼。轻量级路由器从块统计量预测每个块在每种层级下的误差，仅当预测误差降低足以证明额外计算合理时将块移至更准确层级，单一价格设定这一权衡。融合内核在RTX Blackwell GPU的FP4张量核心上单次执行所有三个层级。在Wan2.2、HunyuanVideo和LTX-2.5上，Triage相比稠密FlashAttention将端到端生成加速高达2.32倍，

extra.description: Attention over tens of thousands of visual tokens dominates the inference of video diffusion transformers (DiTs). Existing methods reduce this cost through sparsity, low precision, or both, but use a single precision for all kept tiles. We observe that the output error introduced by approximation varies widely across tiles. Many tiles can be skipped with little error, others must be computed but gain little beyond low precision, and a few retain substantial error even at low precision. We present Triage, a training-free attention method that assigns each tile one of three approximation tiers: skipping it by replacing it with its block means, skimming it in NVFP4, or refining it with NVFP4 residual correction. A lightweight router predicts each tile's error under each tier from block statistics and moves a tile to a more accurate tier only when the predicted error reduction justifies the extra compute, with a single price setting this trade-off. A fused kernel executes all three tiers in a single pass on the FP4 tensor cores of RTX Blackwell GPUs. Across Wan2.2, HunyuanVideo, and LTX-2.5, Triage accelerates end-to-end generation by up to 2.32x over dense FlashAttention, and in each of five settings it runs faster than every baseline while reaching 0.3-3.0 dB higher PSNR than the highest-PSNR baseline.

items.title: Towards a Unified Framework of Optimal Input-Side Dimensional Configuration for Deep CTR Prediction
items.title_zh: 面向深度CTR预测最优输入侧维度配置的统一框架
items.summary_zh: 深度点击率（CTR）预测通过日益表达性的特征交互架构取得了巨大成功。然而，预测性能还取决于交互建模之前输入侧信息如何配置。现有研究表明，选择信息丰富的样本、特征或嵌入单元可以提高预测准确率。然而，它们主要沿单一输入侧维度独立优化这些选择机制，忽视了其共享的基本形式以及输入层级之间的固有依赖，从而限制了输入侧维度配置的有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出OptIDC，一个用于深度CTR预测中最优输入侧维度配置的统一框架。OptIDC通过整合相应的选择机制，在统一框架内联合学习样本、特征和嵌入单元级配置。为明确协调不同层级的选择决策，OptIDC进一步引入选择加权最优传输机制，通过有限测度上的传输对齐粗粒度和细粒度选择，从而缓解跨层选择冲突，同时保留每个输入层级的语义。此外，OptIDC与模型无关，可无缝集成到现有CTR模型中。在四个真实世界基准数据集上的大量实验表明，OptIDC始终比现有输入侧

extra.description: Deep click-through rate (CTR) prediction has achieved substantial success through increasingly expressive feature interaction architectures. However, predictive performance also depends on how input-side information is configured before interaction modeling. Existing studies have shown that selecting informative samples, features, or embedding units can improve prediction accuracy. Nevertheless, they primarily optimize these selection mechanisms independently along a single input-side dimension, overlooking their shared basic form and the inherent dependencies across input levels, thereby limiting the effectiveness of input-side dimensional configuration. To address this issue, we propose OptIDC, a unified framework for Optimal Input-side Dimensional Configuration in deep CTR prediction. OptIDC jointly learns sample, feature, and embedding-unit level configurations within a unified framework by integrating their corresponding selection mechanisms. To explicitly coordinate selection decisions across different levels, OptIDC further introduces a selection-weighted Optimal Transport mechanism that aligns coarse- and fine-grained selections via transport over finite measures, thereby alleviating cross-level selection conflicts while preserving the semantics of each input level. Moreover, OptIDC is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing CTR models. Extensive experiments on four real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that OptIDC consistently achieves higher AUC than existing input-side selection methods, validating the effectiveness of unified input-side dimensional configuration.

items.title: Signal Associa: hot tumors elicit field-spanning NK cell coordination linked to their recruitment
items.title_zh: Signal Associa：热肿瘤引发与招募相关的跨场NK细胞协调
items.summary_zh: 细胞通过耦合动力学进行协调，但观察到的相关性是否反映真正的耦合很少被检验。Signal Associa是一个开源框架，将六种耦合方法与自动平稳化和替代测试相结合。针对六个真值系统进行基准测试，揭示了耦合机制的三分法，每种都有不同的最佳方法：相关性用于由共享趋势和周期承载的耦合，Granger因果用于线性随机耦合，收敛交叉映射用于非线性耦合；方法间的一致性从数据中识别机制。在三个结直肠肿瘤微环境中的13部自然杀伤（NK）细胞电影中，NK细胞以保守速率形成跨场耦合网络；在匹配的肿瘤信号暴露下，热肿瘤周围的NK细胞更全局整合，而具有更整合NK网络的热肿瘤倾向于吸引更多NK细胞。在黏着斑中，刚度增强了vinculin-FAK耦合，在突出边缘最为明显。替代测试将滞后相关假阳性从23-92%降至约5%。

extra.description: Cells coordinate through coupled dynamics, yet whether observed correlations reflect genuine coupling is rarely tested. Signal Associa is an open-source framework uniting six coupling methods with automated stationarization and surrogate testing. Benchmarking against six ground truth systems reveals a trichotomy of coupling regimes, each with a different best method: correlation for coupling carried by shared trends and cycles, Granger causality for linear stochastic coupling, and convergent cross-mapping for nonlinear coupling; agreement across methods identifies the regime from data. In 13 movies of natural killer (NK) cells across three colorectal tumor microenvironments, NK cells formed field-spanning coupling networks at a conserved rate; at matched exposure to tumor signal, NK cells around hot tumors were more globally integrated, and hot tumors with a more integrated NK network tended to attract more NK cells. In focal adhesions, stiffness strengthened vinculin-FAK coupling, most at protruding edges. Surrogates cut lagged-correlation false positives from 23-92% to about 5%.

items.title: Metabolic blueprints of monocultures enable prediction and design of synthetic microbial consortia
items.title_zh: 单培养的代谢蓝图使合成微生物群落的预测和设计成为可能
items.summary_zh: 合成微生物生态学旨在理解复杂微生物动力学并设计具有所需特性的群落，通常基于个体生物的数学模型。然而，尚不清楚简化模型是否包含足够细节来预测合成群落的组成，尤其是在代谢复杂环境中。在此，我们使用15种根际细菌单培养的纵向外代谢物数据来参数化消费者-资源模型，并用其预测成对共培养和更高阶群落。在模型中人工关闭交叉喂养相互作用的能力证明了它们在生态系统结构中的重要性。留一和留二实验揭示，成对共培养不一定能捕捉更大群落内的种间相互作用，并广泛突显了相互作用的非线性。最后，我们说明我们的模型可用于识别三种菌株具有高共存可能性的新子群落。我们的结果突显了未来工作需解决的实验和理论挑战，并确立混合机理和数据驱动代谢模型作为预测和工程化微生物群落的有前景框架。

extra.description: Synthetic microbial ecology aims at understanding complex microbial dynamics and designing communities with desired properties, often based on mathematical models of individual organisms. However, it is unclear whether simplified models harbor enough detail to predict the composition of synthetic communities, especially in metabolically complex environments. Here, we use longitudinal exometabolite data of monocultures for 15 rhizosphere bacteria to parametrize a consumer-resource model, which we use to predict pairwise co-cultures and higher order communities. The capacity to artificially switch off cross-feeding interactions in the model demonstrates their importance in ecosystem structure. Leave-one-out and leave-two-out experiments reveal that pairwise co-cultures do not necessarily capture inter-species interactions within larger communities and broadly highlight the nonlinearity of interactions. Finally, we illustrate that our model can be used to identify new sub-communities of three strains with high likelihood of coexistence. Our results highlight experimental and theoretical challenges to be addressed in future efforts and establish hybrid mechanistic and data-driven metabolic models as a promising framework for predicting and engineering microbial communities.
